contribution: Methods for estimating demand and market power in differentiated-product industries, which founded modern empirical industrial organization and are now standard in antitrust and merger analysis
rationale: Recent prizes covered labor (2021, 2023), institutions (2024) and innovation-driven growth (2025), so empirical industrial organization looks overdue. The Berry-Levinsohn-Pakes (BLP) framework is among the most cited and most widely applied empirical tools in economics, and Pakes has long been a perennial frontrunner.
